citations.title: PJM, 2020–2024 Weighted Average EFORd by Fuel Type (Class Average Values effective 1 June 2025)
citations.parameter: FOR = PJM Combined Cycle WEFORd 3.936 % (proxy: gas-fired CHP)

notes: Expected hourly availability = (1-FOR)*(1-planned share)*(1-ambient derate); FOR=0.039, planned outage 21 d/yr. Availability only — heat-led dispatch is left to the model. Planned outage in summer (low heat demand) is a modelling assumption.
